description: Plain-English structured summary of one case: debtor, chapter, court, case number, key dates (filed, plan confirmed, discharged, closed), asset/liability ranges, nature of business, judge, and AI-extracted case profile data when available. ranges.assets and ranges.liabilities are the petition checkbox buckets (including "Unknown"). amounts.assets and amounts.liabilities are numeric dollar totals only, and are null when the stored value is a range label rather than a point amount. Null is not zero. Pass simple_name (preferred, see list_monitored_cases_tool) or a 7-digit case_number. Subscribers only.

case_number.description: 7-digit short case number (e.g. 26-10543). Pass court to pick one court when the number is reused.

court.description: Court name as returned in the court field, for example "Delaware" or "Texas Southern".

court_state.description: 2-letter state. Matches every district in that state.

name: get_case_summary_tool
